validationScope: Two complete desktop/keyboard and iPad-viewport/touch upper-floor routes, including original third-to-second comics, eight physical-lane answers and second-to-hallway comics. Closed/open room-door proportions, floor anchoring, actor foreground, transparency and first-floor room/exit artwork distinction verified. 306 model tests and exact source TypeScript/Vite build pass. No physics, collision, maps, puzzles, story, CSS or original artwork changed. Physical iPad is not claimed.
features: Offline sprite trimming, white-edge removal, frame/feet alignment and seven lossless WebP atlases; no application pixel readback on startup
Staged title, opening, attic, chase, hallway, independent room and ending loading, with original clocks frozen while destinations wait
Shared prioritized three-image loading/decode queue; released stale decoded images; obsolete queued work canceled without deleting HTTP cache
Lossless/full-resolution display artwork, original runtime Canvas preparation dimensions, smaller site icons and deferred hidden previews
Nine genuine MP3 BGM derivatives preserve exact playable sample counts/rates/channels; three original MP3 effects and AudioManager behavior retained
Once-per-load original-size Canvas raster cache restores rendering throughput without pixel reads; evicted backing stores are released
Both upper-floor exits reuse the original paired room-door artwork, with existing 0.24s crossfade and unchanged clear conditions; only the first-floor final exit uses exit-door artwork.

performance.scope: One controlled local cold/warm sample per viewport and build. CDP20MiB/s/40ms, desktop Chrome. Separate real attic FPS samples without trace/throttling. iPad is emulation, not hardware. Full report in source repository PERFORMANCE_REPORT.md.
